evidence_for: Direct mathematical and empirical proof: On calibration set, Platt scaling flips 97/246 (39.4%) samples from non-Psoriasis to Psoriasis, causing 238/246 (96.8%) of calibration samples to be predicted as Psoriasis. Platt intercepts (-1.20 Pso vs -2.96 SD) inject heavy prior, mapping uniform [0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25] to 47.6% Psoriasis. Even when raw RF predicts LP at 35% and Pso at 20%, Platt flips calibrated argmax to Psoriasis (43.5%).
evidence_against: Platt reduces ECE from 0.2488 to 0.1479 on within-distribution confidence calibration.
verification_method: Evaluate inference pipeline using raw RF argmax vs calibrated argmax on external images.

evidence_for: Empirical 5-fold evaluation: BDA drops Macro-F1 by 0.0527 (0.7264 -> 0.6737) and Balanced Acc by 0.0611. Psoriasis false positives surge from 127 to 160 (+26.0%). BDA selected 190 deep features and ZERO LAB color features. BDA proxy classifier was unweighted LogisticRegression without sample weights. Jaccard stability between folds is only 0.0761.
evidence_against: BDA reduced feature dimensionality from 1316 to 194.
verification_method: Compare full A7 1316-D vs BDA 194-D across development folds.

evidence_for: Psoriasis accounts for 638/1146 (55.67%) of development set, outnumbering Seborrheic Dermatitis (88, 7.68%) by 7.25:1 and Pityriasis Rosea (162, 14.14%) by 3.94:1. In DermNet source dataset alone, Psoriasis accounts for 779 images vs 83 for SD.
evidence_against: Phase 2 stratified folds maintained exact class proportions across splits.
verification_method: Examine class distribution in fold_plan.csv and metadata.

evidence_for: In Phase 10 XAI, pre-softmax Psoriasis logit was +20.25 for true Lichen Planus (PSD_00000639) and +11.45 for true Pityriasis Rosea (PSD_00000735). TreeSHAP shows 95.7%-98.7% attribution concentrated in deep EfficientNet branch.
evidence_against: Phase 3 standalone classifier had only 74 Psoriasis FPs (46.3% Psoriasis predictions) due to inverse-frequency sample weights.
verification_method: Evaluate feature embeddings with t-SNE/UMAP and check class separation in 1280-D space.

cause_name: Random Forest Gini Impurity Majority Preference
evidence_for: Moving from Phase 3 Dense head to Random Forest on full A7 increased Psoriasis false positives from 74 to 127 (+71.6%). Gini impurity splitting naturally favors majority class variance across 300 unconstrained trees.
evidence_against: RF fit used sample_weight=sw_train computed from fold class weights.
verification_method: Fit balanced Random Forest (class_weight='balanced_subsample') and measure minority recall.

evidence_for: External dermatological images differ in camera sensor, lighting, skin tone, magnification, and background. When OOD features are fed to RF, tree traversal falls into majority leaves; Platt then maps diffuse probabilities into 41-56% Psoriasis.
evidence_against: Pretrained EfficientNet-B0 generalizes well on ImageNet domains; standard normalization matches training.
verification_method: Test external images with known ground truth under controlled camera/lighting conditions.

cause_name: Absence of Focal Loss / Advanced Imbalance Loss
evidence_for: Focal loss was never implemented or compiled in Phase 3. Standard categorical cross-entropy was used with inverse-frequency sample weights. Sample weighting in standard cross-entropy scales gradient magnitude but does not dynamically down-weight easy majority examples.
evidence_against: Sample weighting was active and reduced Phase 3 standalone Psoriasis recall to 71.6%.
verification_method: Run controlled Phase 3 V2 with Alpha-Balanced Focal Loss vs Standard Cross-Entropy.

verification_method: Verified code path in modules/inference.py matches image_loader.py.

evidence_for: None: Conformal prediction is NOT responsible for Psoriasis argmax. At marginal threshold 0.2178, it correctly outputs multi-class sets {Psoriasis, Pityriasis_Rosea} and triggers SPECIALIST_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
verification_method: Verified mathematical definition: conformal thresholding operates on calibrated probabilities.

evidence_for: Zero test set leakage: holdout_test (243 images) is strictly locked and unaccessed. 264 unverified augmentations were quarantined. Patient-level metadata is absent in DermNet, but strict duplicate hash filtering removed 632 exact/near duplicates.
evidence_against: Source-level distribution differs by class (DermNet vs Atlas vs SkinDisNet).
verification_method: Audit hash integrity and verify no PSD IDs overlap across train/val/test splits.
